basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 is for one Project Nurse post. The post is on contract in an ICMR-funded research project in the Medical Oncology department of the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry/Karaikal. It is for a likely duration of 1 year and pays a consolidated Rs 33,600 per month, including HRA. Candidates need 12th Pass in Science Subjects and BSc Nursing or its equivalent, registration as a nurse with any State Nursing Council and fluency in Tamil. important_dates.exam_date: To be notified (one week in advance)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications (5 November 2026). The application form asks for your age on that date in years, months and days.

qualification.details: 12th Pass in Science Subjects and BSc Nursing or its equivalent Registered Nurse with any State Nursing Council Fluency (speaking, reading and writing) in Tamil, because the project involves interaction with patients and taking their consent

how_to_apply: Print the application form attached to the notice (REC-03: Application Format) on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen.
Affix a recent passport-size photo in the space provided. Do not staple it.

Complete every part of the form: personal details, any SC/ST/OBC status (attach proof), the criminal case or disciplinary action question, Tamil and other language proficiency, educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment, a description of your experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications, willingness to travel, contact details of previous employers, and the signed declaration.
Scan the filled form together with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF.
Name the PDF in the format "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application").
Email the PDF to [email protected], with the name of the post applied for (Project Nurse) in the email subject line.
Send the complete application by 5 November 2026, up to 5 pm.
A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, scanned with its enclosures, in a separate email.
All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order (checklist in the application form):
Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate)
Proof of prior research experience, if any

The form also asks for self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of SC/ST/OBC status where claimed, PDFs of proof of work for previous employment, and details of any criminal case or enquiry if the answer to that question is yes. You must give the contact details of previous employers, and the notice asks you to tell those people that JIPMER may call them.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Incomplete applications, and applications from candidates who do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Giving wrong or false information at any stage, or canvassing of any kind, will lead to disqualification. If it is found after engagement, it may lead to termination. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

Maximum 30 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: 12th Pass in Science Subjects and BSc Nursing or its equivalent Registered Nurse with any State Nursing Council Fluency (speaking, reading and writing) in Tamil, because the project involves interaction with patients and taking their consent Experience working with hematology or oncology patients Experience in clinical research and data collection Any kind of research experience The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications (5 November 2026). The application form asks for your age on that date in years, months and days. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. The qualification, experience and other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the nature of work and responsibilities as: Collection of blood samples, and information from patient records Data collection from patients Data entry in the database Helping in management of inventory of consumables The application form also says the project work involves travel to the field or to other centres for the study. Applicants must state whether they are willing to do this.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Nurse
content_sections.text: Print the application form attached to the notice (REC-03: Application Format) on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport-size photo in the space provided. Do not staple it. Complete every part of the form: personal details, any SC/ST/OBC status (attach proof), the criminal case or disciplinary action question, Tamil and other language proficiency, educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment, a description of your experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications, willingness to travel, contact details of previous employers, and the signed declaration. Scan the filled form together with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF. Name the PDF in the format "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application"). Email the PDF to [email protected] , with the name of the post applied for (Project Nurse) in the email subject line. Send the complete application by 5 November 2026, up to 5 pm. A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, scanned with its enclosures, in a separate email. All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order (checklist in the application form): Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Any others (if relevant; specify) Proof of prior research experience, if any The form also asks for self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of SC/ST/OBC status where claimed, PDFs of proof of work for previous employment, and details of any criminal case or enquiry if the answer to that question is yes. You must give the contact details of previous employers, and the notice asks you to tell those people that JIPMER may call them.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted on the details given in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. Evaluation stages: after the application forms are evaluated, the notice lists the recruitment process as a written test, a skill test and an interview. It does not give the areas each stage will cover. Shortlisting: only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If the number of applications is very large, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. Interview mode: the interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a video interview, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera, plus an adequate internet connection. Schedule: the date and time of the written exam and interview will be notified one week in advance. The decision of the Project Investigator will be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Incomplete applications, and applications from candidates who do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Giving wrong or false information at any stage, or canvassing of any kind, will lead to disqualification. If it is found after engagement, it may lead to termination. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Project Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Project Nurse, in an ICMR-funded project in the Medical Oncology department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Nurse post?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be emailed by 5 November 2026, up to 5 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the JIPMER Project Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates need 12th Pass in Science Subjects and BSc Nursing or its equivalent, must be a Registered Nurse with any State Nursing Council, and must speak, read and write Tamil fluently.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JIPMER Project Nurse post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, which is 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Project Nurse?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated remuneration of Rs 33,600 per month, which includes HRA. The notice says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any other allowance paid on top of the Rs 33,600?
faq.answer: No. HRA is already included in the Rs 33,600 per month, and the notice says no other allowances are payable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the JIPMER Project Nurse post?
faq.answer: Fill in the attached application form, scan it with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF named "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", and email it to [email protected] by 5 November 2026, 5 pm.

faq.question: Q8. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write the name of the post you are applying for, Project Nurse, in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the JIPMER Project Nurse post?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted on their application, CV and documents. The final selection is based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview, and the notice also lists a skill test as an evaluation stage. The interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JIPMER Project Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on contract for an externally sponsored project, with a likely duration of 1 year. It may be extended or curtailed at the Project Investigator's discretion and gives no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.
